name: garry-ai
description: Connect Codex to a scoped RC.VOID instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped RC.VOID tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to RC.VOID through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so RC.VOID Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use RC.VOID only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
